healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Home-based provider of personal care, hospice and skilled home health.

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Personal care for activities of daily living, hospice comfort care and skilled home health.

patient_activity_volume.label: Patient activity / volume
patient_activity_volume.value: Patient volume is concentrated in personal care, with a smaller combined hospice and home health caseload.

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Medicaid and Medicaid managed care lead personal care revenue. Medicare is the primary payer for hospice and home health.

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Personal care is generally billed by service time, Medicare hospice by day and Medicare home health by care period.

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Multistate branch network for personal care, hospice and home health.

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Older adults and people with disabilities or chronic illness, including those at risk of hospitalization or institutionalization, plus hospice and skilled home health patients.

notes: The website lists private pay as an option and leaves the payer revenue breakdown unspecified.
